info.name: KARTSEEK — 06 Marketplace (Full Suite)
info.description:
Comprehensive Marketplace API collection covering all 89+ verified endpoints across Customer, Admin, and Seller portals. Organized into 6 sections with automated test scripts.

**Variables needed:**
- `base_url` - API base (default: http://localhost:3001/api/v1)
- `user_token` - Customer JWT token
- `admin_token` - Admin JWT token
- `seller_token` - Seller JWT token
- `seller_id` - Test seller ID
- `product_id` - Sample product ID
- `category_id` - Sample category ID
- `order_id` - Sample order ID
